decision: Elastic net alpha and xgboost depth / leaf size chosen by pitcher-grouped CV inside each training window
alternative_tested: Fixed values (alpha 0.5; depth 4, leaves of 50+ TBF)
evidence: Backtest blend RMSE 0.03954 vs 0.03953 and log-loss 0.53369 for both: no accuracy cost, and three hand-picked constants become a procedure; the MiLB translation improves from 0.0594 to 0.0584

decision: No explicit Age x Stuff+ term (XGBoost can still find the interaction)
alternative_tested: Add a centered Age x prior Stuff+ interaction
evidence: Backtest blend RMSE 0.0396 with it vs 0.0395 without; the elastic net got worse (0.0400 vs 0.0398)

decision: Tree count chosen by pitcher-grouped CV inside the training seasons
alternative_tested: Tree count chosen on the validation season itself
evidence: 2024 RMSE 0.0397 vs 0.0396: the validation-season pick looks 0.0001 better only because it is tuned on the season it is scored on
2024 RMSE 0.0395 vs 0.0397 (90% bootstrap interval of the difference includes 0); outputs bounded in (0,1) by construction; gbm is no longer maintained

decision: Shrink trailing and lagged K% before the elastic net and xgboost see them
evidence: Backtest blend RMSE 0.0395 vs 0.0396; a 3-for-3 prior season moves the forecast to 23.4% instead of 28.4% (tests/test_pipeline.R)

decision: Leave whiff%, Stuff+ and other tracking rates unshrunk
